# How this project works

A Ktor backend and a SvelteKit frontend that ship as one JAR, wired together by the ktor-svelte Gradle plugin.
Kotlin lives in `src/main/kotlin`, the frontend in this folder's project. The docs are at https://nijasc.github.io/ktor-svelte, with the full text at
https://nijasc.github.io/ktor-svelte/llms-full.txt.

## Files you must not edit by hand

They are generated. An edit is overwritten, and `./gradlew check` fails when they are out of date.

- `src/lib/ktor-svelte/`: written by `./gradlew svelteSync` from `svelte { libraries { } }` in `build.gradle.kts`. Change that block.
- `src/lib/api/`: the typed API client, written by `./gradlew svelteGenerateTs` from the Ktor routes. Change the route in Kotlin.
- `vite.config.ts`, `src/hooks.server.ts`, `src/hooks.client.ts`: written by `svelteSync`. Your own Vite settings go in `vite.user.ts`.
- The frontend packages the libraries need are added to `package.json` by `svelteSync`. Do not remove them.

## Calling the backend

- Every API route has a typed function in `src/lib/api/services.ts`. Read that file for what exists. Do not guess paths.
- In components: `import { api } from '#api'`, then `await api.notes.list()`.
- In a `load` function: `apiWith(event)` instead of `api`, so SvelteKit's `fetch` is used.
- Do not write `fetch('/api/...')` by hand, and do not write request or response types by hand. They come from `#api`.
- A failed call throws `ApiError`. Use `isValidationError`, `errorMessage` and the other helpers exported by `#api`.
- To add or change an endpoint: edit the Kotlin route, then run `./gradlew svelteGenerateTs`. In dev mode this happens on restart.

## Pages and links

Link to pages through `import { routes } from '#routes'`, such as `href={routes.home()}`. Do not write page paths as strings.
In Kotlin, redirects use the generated `FrontendRoutes` object. After adding, moving or deleting a page, run
`./gradlew svelteSync`. To rename one, use `./gradlew svelteRename --page <old> --to <new>`.

| Name | Page |
|---|---|
| `routes.home` | `/` |
| `routes.admin` | `/(app)/admin` |
| `routes.board` | `/(app)/board` |
| `routes.settings` | `/(app)/settings` |
| `routes.tasksId` | `/(app)/tasks/[id]` |
| `routes.tasksNew` | `/(app)/tasks/new` |
| `routes.about` | `/about` |
| `routes.login` | `/login` |
| `routes.register` | `/register` |

## Libraries that are set up

- Styling is Tailwind with DaisyUI. Themes are `nord`, `dracula`, set in Gradle. Switch with `setTheme` from `#theme`. Use DaisyUI classes and theme colors, not fixed colors.
- Icons: `import Icon from '#icon'`, then `<Icon name="Rocket" />`. Names are type checked. After using a new icon, run `./gradlew svelteSync`.
- Texts: add the key to every file in `messages/` (`en.json`, `de.json`), run `./gradlew svelteSync`, then use `m.key()` from `#i18n`. Do not put user-visible text into components directly.
- Failed API calls already show a toast. Do not add error toasts around API calls. For your own messages use `toast` from `$lib/ktor-svelte/toasts`.
- Images: use `<enhanced:img>` for images in `src`, so they are resized and converted at build time.

## Commands

Run them from the project root. Use the Gradle tasks, not the package manager, so both halves stay in sync.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `./gradlew svelteDevAll` | Starts Ktor and Vite with hot reload. Open the app on Ktor's port |
| `./gradlew svelteSync` | Regenerates `src/lib/ktor-svelte/` and installs the packages it needs |
| `./gradlew svelteGenerateTs` | Regenerates the typed client in `src/lib/api/` |
| `./gradlew check` | Tests, plus checks that generated files, links and the client are current |
| `./gradlew svelteCheck` | Type checks the frontend |
| `./gradlew svelteDoctor` | Finds setup problems. `--fix` repairs what it can |
| `./gradlew buildFatJar` | Builds the one JAR that serves both |
